content: Jesu Ebeine no Luli
Time ebeine no niti, mi osi kulima ni Sitange.
Omutayi onje uli kwa mene nokwa beeka embuya, kame au temako mi omutayi onje ou ubeeka embuya, kame au kolela nji obeeke onene embuya.
Anyi namu kenisiwa mulibaka no liywi nina myambele kale.
Mwikale mwa mene, kanyi mene aba nili mwaanyi. Kanyi omutayi aba kautwese okubeeka embuya wonyene, konji aba okubeeka mu beine, kame kuli ngeso ni kwaanyi, konji aba samukubeeke mwa mene.
Time ebeine, anyi kame muli emitayi. Woyo okubeeka mwa mene, ni mene kame nili mwa yonyene, yokame woyo obeeka embuya onene, kakuli nji sisako ka mutwese okutenda esinjili.
Nji omunu kakubeeke mwa mene, kame akoliwa kanyi omutayi ni kukukuta, mi emitayi kame yungekiwa ni kukondelwa mu mulilo mane ni kubya.
Nji kame mukubekile mwa mene mane amaywi ange kame ali mwaanyi, mukumbele eso sonje musinga mi mbamu sitendelwe.
Ba kutenda ngeso Sitange mba kanyisiwa nji kame mubeeka onene embuya, mi bokame aba samutende aiyetwa ange.
Kanyi Sitange aba ana nisingi ni mene kame nimi singa ngeso, mu yoye mu lilato lyange.
Nji kame muteula etitaelo tange, kame sa mwikale mu lilato lyange, kanyi aba nina mamele etitaelo ta Sitange mane kame niikalile mu lilato lyaye.
Kame nina myambele eyo nji okuwabelelwa kwange kwikale mwaanyi nji cwale okuwabelelwa kwenu kwiyale.
Etaelo yange ninji muku singe omunjili ku munjili, kanyi aba nina misingi.
Kakwisa omunu woyo oli ni lilato no kuneneba okubitelela eli, konji omunu okutoboha omoyo waye mulibaka no alikani aye.
Kame muli alikani ange nji kame mutenda eyo nimi laelela.
Sitamba oku miisana nji muli abika, kakuli omubika ka limuka eso atenda Molyaye. Kono kame nimiisana alikani ange, kakuli kame nina misimwete eyi nina yupu yonje kwa Sitange.
Kasa anyi muna nikete, kono time nina mikete ni kumi tuma nji mute mane muka beeke embuya onene. Cwale embuya yenu iikalelele, nji cwale esi sonje samu kumbele kwa Sitange mu litina lyange amibe so.
Esi nimi laela ninji, muku singe omunjili ku munjili.
Olutimbo no Litunga
Nji elitunga kame limi timbile, mulimuke nji kame lina tateke okutimba mene oweli ekalya sitimba anyi.
Kambe kame muli asi litunga, elitunga kame lisinga esi sili salyo. Kono kakuli kasa muli ano litunga, kono kame nina mikete mu litunga, bokame abo elitunga aba limi timbile.
Mu puluke eliywi elyo nina kumyambele nji, ‘Omubika kasa wakuneneba okubitelela Molyaye.’ Nji kame ani yandisa, mba mi yandisa naanyi, nji kame ana mamele eliywi lyange, mba mamele ngeso ni lyenu.
Kono kame sami tende eyo yonje mulibaka lyange, kakuli kayii woyo ona ni tumu.
Kambe kani siiya mu kwaambela kambe kakwite esibi, kono cwale kaku tatula ku sibi soo.
Woyo onitimbile kame atimbile ngeso ni Sitange.
Kambe ka ni sitenda mukaci koo emisebezi eyo kakwisa omunu ona itende, kambe kakwite esibi kono cwale kame ana mono, mane kame atimbile mene bamweya ni Sitange.
Neli okwiyateteta eliywi elyo lina kun̄oliwa mu mulawo woo nji, ‘Kame ani timbile feela okuulwile omubonda.’
Kono cwale Omombaombi aba saiye, woyo sani tume kwaanyi okutunda kwa Sitange. Simba Emebo no niti eyo saitunde kwa Sitange kame saibe oupaki kwa mene.
Cwale naanyi mba mwipaka, kakuli namwikala ni mene okutunda ku matatekelo.
